editorial.meta_description: Prepare for the NEHA Certified Professional – Food Safety exam covering seven distinct content areas across 140 questions and 150 minutes.
editorial.overview: The Certified Professional – Food Safety credential is offered by NEHA to validate competencies required for industry professionals. This current examination evaluates candidate knowledge across seven distinct content domains, including the development of food safety policies, conducting inspection assessments, performing establishment plan reviews, and coordinating effective emergency responses during significant incidents.
editorial.who_should_take: Food safety professionals, environmental health specialists, regulatory inspectors, and public health officials seeking to validate their knowledge of retail food protection, risk assessment, and operational safety standards.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Review each of the seven content areas outlined in the official NEHA guide by studying hazard analysis principles, local regulations, and inspection equipment calibration methods to prepare carefully for all 140 questions and ensure complete readiness for every single objective tested on the examination.

domain_guidance.summary: This domain covers the processes involved in developing food safety policies, standard operating procedures, and effective training programs designed to mitigate biological, chemical, and physical hazards in various operational environments.

This domain focuses extensively on assessing overall food safety through equipment calibration, proper assembly of required inspection tools, and careful preparation for conducting facility inspections across diverse operational locations.

This domain deals extensively with reviewing establishment blueprints and architectural plans, researching local laws and regulations, comparing facility menus against site conditions, and obtaining necessary operational licenses and permits.
study_focus: Obtain licenses, permits, and variances (including special processes)

domain_guidance.summary: This domain involves collecting initial public complaints, communicating effectively with appropriate regulatory agencies, and managing information exchange with both internal and external stakeholders during formal foodborne illness investigations.
study_focus: Communicate with appropriate agencies regarding the investigation process
Communicate with internal and external stakeholders regarding the investigation process

domain_guidance.summary: This specific domain covers performing necessary recall activities such as training operational staff on safety procedures, conducting structured mock recalls, and submitting required regulatory documentation to ensure compliance.

This particular domain centers on managing food defense practices, conducting vulnerability assessments, identifying potential security hazards, and developing a detailed protection plan to safeguard food supplies against intentional contamination.

This designated domain addresses responding to emergencies, coordinating multidisciplinary response teams, identifying associated operational risks, and determining parameters required for safely ceasing facility operations during significant incidents.
study_focus: Identify risks associated with the emergency

editorial.exam_day_guidance: Manage your time carefully during the 150 minutes. Read each question carefully, noting that the 140 total items include both scored questions and unscored pilot questions.

faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?
faq.answer_text: The examination consists of a total of 140 questions, which includes 120 scored operational questions and 20 unscored pilot questions used for evaluation purposes by the administering organization.
The official passing score requirement remains unpublished on the official NEHA PDF guide, meaning candidates should check directly with the organization for specific scoring guidelines.
The official examination duration is exactly 2.5 hours, providing all registered candidates a total of 150 minutes to complete all questions included in the test format.

faq.question_title: What certifying body administers the exam?
faq.answer_text: The examination is administered, managed, and certified by NEHA as a core component of its established professional credentialing program designed specifically for environmental health specialists.

methodology.summary: This page was built using verified official documentation sourced directly from the official NEHA exam guide, covering structured domains, exact question counts, and duration details.
